closure_records.strongest_attack: The thirteen words could be a stitching taxonomy that falsely linearizes heterogeneous carrier types. The attack partially succeeds: the exact macro-view is new, the prospective front edge is not executable, AttemptAdmission semantics conflict across profiles, and no single harness spans all thirteen burdens. It does not collapse the object because the core and late causal joins, identities, non-conversions, failure states, and bounded compositions are already executable and source-bound.

findings.five_term_cycle: FIELD -> REFRACT -> TRANSLATE -> GOVERN -> RETURN survives only as a morphological cycle hypothesis, not five peer organs.
findings.resolution_geometry: Raw views form a factorization preorder; kernels or views modulo mutual determinacy form a partial order with incomparable resolutions, alongside overlapping role-slice participation rather than a single hierarchy.
findings.cohesion: Cohesion is persistence of an attributable differentiated relation across time or resolution change; it is neither sameness nor an action-bound adequacy certificate.
findings.external_closure_signal: Repeated model closure may indicate functional altitude or recurring morphology, but prompt-induced alignment and summary compression are competing explanations; stability must be tested with pinned prompts/models, label permutation, blind coding, anti-collapse instructions, and negative controls.
findings.strict_middle: BUF-007 and BUF-002 could supply a finite safe-merge/must-distinguish witness once an endpoint map, profile, and consequential semantics are independently defined and the BUF-002 pair is proved to share an endpoint; the proof is not yet present.
findings.next_burden: Bind the PreparedPossibilityField/BearingOffer front edge into exact SourcePoint authorship and ONE-RCC commitment; split the colliding AttemptAdmission profiles; repair validation of the generated MUS settlement receipt; then run one hostile route spanning all thirteen burdens.
